<think>The user asks: "Recomienda tres libros sobre aprendizaje automático adecuados para un lector de nivel intermedio. Cada entrada: title, author, year, why_recommended."

They want a JSON output with three entries, each containing title, author, year, why_recommended. So I need to output a JSON array of objects with those fields.

The user is speaking Spanish, wants recommendations. So I should answer in Spanish or at least include Spanish content. The system says "Solo produce un objeto JSON válido — sin prosa, sin markdown." So I must output only a valid JSON object, no extra text, no markdown, no explanation. Just the JSON.

Thus I need to produce something like:

[
  {
    "title": "...",
    "author": "...",
    "year": ...,
    "why_recommended": "..."
  },
  ...
]

Make sure it's valid JSON. Use double quotes for keys and strings. Year is a number. Provide three books.

- "Hands-On Machine Learning with Scikit-Learn, Keras, and TensorFlow" by Aurélien Géron (2nd edition 2019, but maybe 3rd edition 2022). Provide year.

- "Machine Learning Yearning" by Andrew Ng is more strategic, but maybe not intermediate. Better: "Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning" by Christopher Bishop (2006) is more advanced, but could be intermediate.

- "Deep Learning" by Ian Goodfellow, Yoshua Bengio, Aaron Courville (2016) is intermediate/advanced.

- "The Elements of Statistical Learning" by Trevor Hastie, Robert Tibshirani, Jerome Friedman (2009) is advanced.

- "Machine Learning: A Probabilistic Perspective" by Kevin P. Murphy (2012) is intermediate.

- "Introduction to Machine Learning with Python" by Andreas Müller
